title: Privacy registers and incidents
lead: Own processing, processor and transfer evidence and incident response. Review the exact saved record before recording a human review.
empty: No controlled records in this view. Add a working record and assign its next action.
inactiveOwner: Owner unavailable — assign an active staff member
confirm: I reviewed this exact saved revision and source evidence within my allocated authority.
policyHelp: Policy and notification decisions come from the responsible qualified person. Unknown fields hold review. Enter the notification instant and timezone from that person’s decision.
dataHelp: Use minimised scope and restricted evidence references. Keep customer details in their protected source records.
timeHelp: Enter an ISO 8601 date and time with an explicit UTC offset. Notification instants also require an IANA timezone and a qualified source.
savedNext: Open the current record, resolve missing evidence and review the exact saved revision.
reviewedNext: The named human review is retained with its source, revision and receipt. Actual agency policy acceptance remains a separate owner decision.
missing: Evidence or active ownership needed before review
workingChanged: This working revision has changed since the latest review. The prior reviewed evidence remains available below.
qualifiedRequired: An explicitly allocated qualified claim reviewer must record the incident notification determination. Save the working record and use the manual review path.
denied: Your current access does not cover these privacy settings. Ask the access manager for the specific settings and privacy allocation.
stepUp: Verify your passkey again before reading or changing privacy operating records.
failed: This operation was not confirmed. Check its exact receipt before making another attempt.
invalid: Check the marked fields and the evidence needed for review.
conflict: The record or review intent changed. Open the current record and review it before submitting again.
pending: The result is pending or unknown. Check this exact operation; do not create a replacement submission.
absent: No receipt exists for this exact actor, record, command and key. No success is confirmed.

timer.title: Owned response and review timer
timer.overdue: Target reached — review the next action
